reason: The cited evidence does not address refractory HEA coatings on TC4. E1 discusses RHEAs generally but is truncated before providing specific evidence. E2 and E3 describe laser cladding of TiAl-based coatings on TC4, not refractory HEAs, and do not support claims about BCC phase formation, bonding, or preservation of TC4's bulk properties.
premises: Laser cladding can produce a dense, low-porosity refractory HEA coating on TC4
The refractory HEA coating will form a fine-grained, predominantly BCC solid solution microstructure
The coating will form a strong metallurgical bond with the TC4 substrate
The BCC microstructure provides dispersion and solid solution strengthening, enhancing hardness and wear resistance
The coating will preserve the intrinsic light weight and strength of TC4
